items.text: Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.
Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

2026-11-07.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

### Bug Fixes
- Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
- DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

items.text: Night vision goggles no longer get stuck, and scientists' NVG suits correctly display glowing eyes after trophy head removal.
Overly bright flares in the Floating City have been dimmed to normal levels.
Sleeping bags can no longer be placed or respawn in spaces too tight for a player, preventing stuck-on-respawn bugs; a warning toast alerts when placement would block respawn.
The disabled blueprint tooltip now correctly shows "cannot learn" information.
Watercatcher and chicken coop loot panels automatically select the bucket when it’s in the belt.
The flamethrower fuel gauge needle now accurately reflects fuel level and includes a subtle wobble animation.

Backpacks are now considered for many item lookups, allowing mission items, tech tree unlocks, vending machines and other systems to pull required items from backpacks (crafting, building, and weapon reloads still ignore backpacks).
Shutter doors now correctly retain their open/closed state when entering a new network range, preventing unexpected frame changes.
Painting tablet strokes remain smooth during fast drawing, eliminating broken dot artifacts.

2026-11-06.summary:
### Equipment & Wearables
- Night vision goggles no longer get stuck, and scientists' NVG suits correctly display glowing eyes after trophy head removal.

### Environmental & World Interaction
- Overly bright flares in the Floating City have been dimmed to normal levels.
- Sleeping bags can no longer be placed or respawn in spaces too tight for a player, preventing stuck-on-respawn bugs; a warning toast alerts when placement would block respawn.

### UI & HUD
- The disabled blueprint tooltip now correctly shows "cannot learn" information.
- Watercatcher and chicken coop loot panels automatically select the bucket when it’s in the belt.
- The flamethrower fuel gauge needle now accurately reflects fuel level and includes a subtle wobble animation.

### Inventory & Crafting
- Backpacks are now considered for many item lookups, allowing mission items, tech tree unlocks, vending machines and other systems to pull required items from backpacks (crafting, building, and weapon reloads still ignore backpacks).

### Bug Fixes
- Shutter doors now correctly retain their open/closed state when entering a new network range, preventing unexpected frame changes.
- Painting tablet strokes remain smooth during fast drawing, eliminating broken dot artifacts.
